tasks.title: E11 in full from its design
tasks.brief: You are the only coder on epic E11 (Urgent handling and pathway engine). Implement it in full from its design docs/tdd/E11.md: every section, and every R, V and D of its acceptance matrix with a test, including end to end tests on the real stack. docs/build/E11/PLAN.md and ticket_tasks in docs/build/E11/tasks.json describe one split of this work with briefs, tests and gates: use them as a guide and checklist; the design and docs/SYSTEM.md win where they differ. Build in this order: domain, application, adapters, api, user interface, and run your tests as you go. If an epic you depend on has no code yet, code against its port protocol and the kernel fakes (docs/SYSTEM.md section 10).

ticket_tasks.title: Urgency rules, exhaustive classification and canonical ports
ticket_tasks.brief:
Read AGENTS.md, docs/SYSTEM.md and docs/requests/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md first, in that order, then every reads entry. This is the complete fresh-session brief. Edit only owned_paths from E11 section 13. Recheck the current tree, all docs/build/*/tasks.json and provider declarations before creating files. At planning time no hub/, ui/ or eval/ exists and config/contracts contain only pharmacy artifacts. Create no replacement provider, generated type, clinical content, shared toolchain or sample-data fallback. The design is frozen. No git commands. No em/en dash or spaced hyphen dash. No edits to requests or AI-USE-LOG.md; return the exact missing declaration and AI-use evidence to the coordinator.

SYSTEM 5.1 supplies IdFactory/require_id; 5.2 supplies Clock/TimeInput/corrections/segments; 5.3 supplies MissionClock; 5.4 supplies Decimal Quantity/Unit and wire conversion; 5.5 supplies ProblemError/StorageUnavailable and generated ErrorEnvelope mapping under D5; 5.6 supplies snapshot-bound ReleaseHandle/ConfigReader/ConfigReleaseReader; 5.7 supplies StorageSession, UnitOfWork, ReadSnapshot, Actor/SessionContext, domain bus, outbox and replication; 5.8 supplies CommandIdentity, IdempotencyStore, CommandIntents, CommandReceipts and ResultVisibility; 5.9 supplies whole-envelope reference-only audit; 5.10/5.10.1 supply scheduler, health, task execution and generations; 5.10.2 supplies EvaluationIsolation; 5.11 supplies bounded HubSettings/SettingSpec; 5.12 supplies ModuleRegistry. Use these by their exact declarations, never a local clock, ledger, UOW, worker queue, retry, hash chain or concurrency mechanism. SYSTEM 6 governs uv --project hub, generated contracts and import discovery. SYSTEM 8.1 fixes E11/E26 ownership, 8.2 clinical eligibility, 8.3 privacy, 8.4 authority, 8.5 home/location and 8.6 durability. Part A D1/D3/D5/D6/D7/D12/D13 and Q1/Q4/Q7/Q16/Q18/Q26 override frozen text. Clinical review is an independent visible label; missing source/hash/purpose/applicability never permits guidance.

Hard prerequisites are real E01/E02/E15-core/E27-guidance (SYSTEM 9); build unit work against exact published ports and E01 kernel.testing (SYSTEM 10) once available. Fakes are test fixtures, never production fallbacks. Optional model/devices/ground cannot block fixed help, record entry or safety. Read PLAN Design deviations and C1 to C9 as binding build direction. They are pending coordinator handoffs because this planning run may edit only docs/build/E11/ and docs/requests/E11.md is absent. Pending schemas/proposals are not callable contracts. Before dependent implementation require accepted complete declarations, generated effective models and provider tests. Work independently where those gaps do not apply. A disabled feature preserves safety but does not satisfy acceptance.

Write critical tests first. Carry T-E11 IDs plus R/V/D or invariant traces from E11 section 12. Use real configuration-derived inputs through explicit test/demo profiles and independently source-checked expected safety outcomes; never derive both a medical input and its expected answer from the same document. Hypothesis covers every classifier/parser/rule. Do not edit safety mappings to prove configurability. Test null/empty/negative/maximum, changed unit where quantities occur, all LIVE/REPLAY/SIM states and source/time lineage. Storage/I/O/integrity errors propagate; privacy caches/logs/errors hold only approved codes/references. A bug gets a failing regression first and the full hub suite after fixing. Gates must execute nonempty owned tests, with no skips/xfails, filters hiding failures or ignored warnings. Done means all assigned tests and exact gates pass, accepted seams are delivered and evidence distinguishes planned from executed, unit doubles from real-stack acceptance, and numerical verification from clinical validation. Final epic greenlight also requires T4, CI, independent review and coordinator AI-use rows. No task edits another task's files; report fixes to their owner.

Build only E11 sections 3.1 to 3.5, 3.8/3.9 and pure parts of 4.3/4.4, as corrected by PLAN. T2 owns SQL, T3 owns pathway/request rules and their evidence mapper, T4 owns all application orchestration, effect delivery, HTTP and complete acceptance. Keep package initializers empty. Own conftest.py supplies explicit configuration builders only, never autouse mocks or composition overrides; other tasks consume it without editing. Complete local ports once, then release T2/T3 in parallel. C2/C3/C4/C5 must settle each affected shared payload before it is exported; do not invent missing DTO fields.

Implement UrgencyState exactly none/needs_urgent_review/active_response/disposition_recorded, UrgentCycle bounded summary, DispositionRecord, all eight signal kinds, transition and invariants from E11 3.1/3.2/3.4 and 5.1 (docs/tdd/E11.md:74,87,134,389). Keep Disposition equal to the HelpAction close enum in requests.schema.json. Use generated enums/nullability and kernel value types, no Pydantic/framework in domain. All raising targets and revision increments follow the transition table: model review only none to review, uncertain review, positive/help/emergency active; no observation/acknowledgment/forecast/ground/model reassurance lowering path. Disposition needs a current non-patient authorized human and current cycle/revision. New real cause after disposition starts the next cycle; old derived cause reconciles to history without reopening, once C3 publishes its exact association fields. Commit sequence determines history; observation/cause lineage controls stale derived facts. Never use delivery time to overwrite newer safety state.

The exhaustive classifier uses the answer's exact questionnaire_version and the same pinned help-presentation/responder-flows release, not active fallback (SYSTEM 5.6). For a known red flag, only consistent absent gives no signal. Consistent opens help_flow yields RedFlagPresent; missing choice on unknown/declined yields RedFlagUncertain, contradictory fields stay uncertain, and present cannot become no signal when opens is null. Use the approved C2 mapping-unavailable outcome rather than inventing a flow or reason. Invalid required mappings reject activation through the owner loader; E11 cannot edit E01's checks. Boundary semantic rejection remains E01/E04; do not mutate stored answers. Every classification and effect retains original configuration provenance; activation never reclassifies accepted answers. Replace T070's safety-disabling edit with a scratch question text/hint change. Do not change question membership or opens mappings in configurability tests.

Authority code validates only the supplied current SYSTEM 8.4 AuthorityDecision for urgency_disposition, excluding the patient and requiring role_assignment_id for acting. Do not reproduce E31 roster/overlay/assignment algorithm or accept plan assignments as clinical authority. T4 maps ClinicalAuthorityQuery through role_reader.py under the same UOW and current grant. Missing authority is denial. AuthorizedOfficer is domain-local proof derived from that decision, never deserialized from model/client input. SessionContext/Actor replace legacy Session/PersonRef at boundaries as C4/C6 settle the mapping; AssistantContext cannot convert to a human actor.

InferenceGate.before_turn precedence follows E11 3.5: non-episode context proceeds with no urgency token; missing/mismatched episode refuses; active response interrupts before missing red flags; missing accepted red flags blocks; otherwise Proceed retains urgent-review notice. Use the C5 complete episode-bound UrgencyToken including no-cycle and material snapshot representation; no two-field anonymous token or separate local snapshot system. still_valid is a snapshot-local predicate used in T4's atomic E13/E12 publication/apply integration, never an authorization to publish later. Full material evidence change invalidates output independently of urgency equality. Do not add a help guard or E13 controller here.

Provided application ports are UrgencyQueries.summary/signals/blocks_resolution, UrgencyCommands.request_review_from_model/start_response/record_disposition, InferenceGate.before_turn/still_valid, RequestGatePort.check and PathwayQueries.get_pathway exactly E11 4.3 (docs/tdd/E11.md:316), with accepted C4/C5 amendments only. UrgencySummary, SignalPage, GateDecision, GateResult, CapabilityFact, RequestContext, PathwayContext, PathwayEvaluation, TurnContext and AssistantContext are incomplete in the frozen design; require coordinator/provider declarations rather than filling gaps with Any/object dictionaries. Domain rules receive pure mapped values, never import another module's domain. Declare E11-owned AssistantTurnControl consumer protocol from docs/tdd/E13.md:488 to preserve no-model-in-safety. Import E15 EpisodeFacts and E31 ClinicalAuthorityQuery only from application.ports. UrgencyChanged is the in-transaction event of E11 4.4; C2/C3 must align the exact fields E15 needs for timeline/cause/revision. No new public urgency event or HTTP endpoint here.

Write T001/002 state-machine properties and complete transition rows; T003 to 019 authority/classifier/cross-record tests; T029/031 gate precedence/races. Correct T019 to reject active fallback. Test every presence/choice/version combination including missing question, missing choice, consistent present without opens, unknown/declined without choice, null and contradiction. Independently checked yes/uncertain/no golden cases prove medicine separately from rendering. Test assistant proof forgery, self-disposition, unshared/currently retired authority and origin/mission mismatch at the pure boundary; T4 proves actual provider enforcement. Cover monotonicity, idempotent old cause and new cycle, closed help never disposition, two episodes with equal cycle numbers, no-cycle token, old observation/cause after disposition, and all absent optional services. Test summary/history/page caps as preconditions using registered HubSettings, no literals. T4 owns T027/028/030 HTTP proof. Done requires these properties, no unapproved shared DTO and all owned gates.

Dependency rule: application/ports.py and application/events.py must import only T1-owned domain/kernel/generated pure types and approved provider application ports, never T2 adapters, T3 domain/pathway.py or domain/request_gate.py, or T4 use_cases. Export the accepted application DTOs here; T3 keeps its pure local inputs/results in its owned domain files and T4 maps between them without domain-to-application imports. This keeps T1 gates runnable before T2/T3. Consume questionnaires.json by exact version, help-presentation.json red_flag_flows/disposition_words and responder-flows.json through the pinned ReleaseHandle; warning-rules.json only through E24 facts and role-rules.json only through E31 authority. E03 owns questionnaire/UI words, E26 help words/flows, E24 warning definitions, E31 authority content. No E11 configuration document or copied clinical rule.

Resolve the local transition-table inconsistency by E11 INV-04 and T009: a ModelReviewRequest does not reopen disposition_recorded; its only state elevation is none to needs_urgent_review. Existing review/active stays at its current state. A genuinely new red-flag/help/rule cause can still start a new cycle. C5 must also expose relevant pending urgency-evaluation status so accepted-but-unevaluated red flags cannot be mistaken for a completed safety gate; use the approved Refused/human-path result until recovery, never optimistic Proceed.

Every rows call has a finite limit within storage.max_rows and every statement is bounded by SYSTEM settings. SQL uses StorageSession only. Do not import sqlite3, open/commit a connection, own WAL/locks, create a clock, prune accepted rows or register a second dedup ledger. Consume UOW.now, IdFactory and the real platform transaction. SIGNAL uniqueness is clinical-effect idempotency, not a replacement command ledger; SYSTEM 5.8 owns command identity and late receipts.

pathways_effect stores the immutable open_help/cancel_turns intent plus approved shared runner references/progress, and origin cycle/signal association from C3/C7. Retain failed/skipped/done history. Do not implement the design's serial custom queue/retry loop or persist raw private model/answer text in payload_json. Due execution is E01 scheduler/tasks; elapsed retry anchors follow SYSTEM 5.2/5.10. Admission/overflow/rearm must use C7 shared semantics, never delete or acknowledge unrecorded work. C3/C7 can require an amended additive schema but cannot be guessed. T4 makes calls outside the writer transaction.

Every mutation must call UOW.replicate with the exact SYSTEM 5.7 ReplicationChange in the same UOW. Urgency has no approved export projection in SYSTEM 5.7.1: export_projection None records local recovery changes only, with reference-only payload and approved audience; do not register a broad urgency projection or dump clinical state. E01 owns the append-only audit hash chain and durable identity. A missing replication declaration fails commit. Migration is expand-only, no destructive rollback or table drop. Retain previous-release compatibility and expose typed StorageUnavailable via E01 for full/locked/io/corrupt; do not catch them as evaluator failure or translate into success.

Write T060 first: bypass domain and attempt rank decrease, change after disposition, empty/whitespace rationale, NULL/empty/non-person/assistant/patient actor, missing disposition signal, acting without assignment, revision/count/sequence skip, cycle before prior disposition, history/link edit/delete. All must abort without committed audit/effect/revision; matching legal writes must pass. T061 and INV-07/12 test duplicate signal/link delivery, correct no-op versus content conflict, concurrent conditional writers and rollback of state/history/replication/audit as one UOW. Repository fault counterparts of T023/026/064 inject kill before/after commit, SQLITE_FULL, locked deadline, I/O/integrity fault, restart and mission-life identity replay. T4 owns the actual HTTP command fault tests. Verify bounded 1000-signal history/summary (T084), stable pagination, no history loss, original timestamps despite clock jump, privacy canaries in reference-only changes and migration upgrade/previous-code use. Configuration rendering test consumes T1's scratch label edit through the same repository queries; no safety mapping changed. Done requires the complete SQL backup evidence, typed bounded adapter and all owned gates.

T2 owns persistence, T4 all command/use-case orchestration/role reader/HTTP and full E11-02 execution. This task performs reads only, never creates a MeasurementRequest/CapabilityGap, writes clinical state or changes urgency. Start after T1, in parallel with T2. C4 is required for incomplete shared DTOs/applicability/method binding; implement no optimistic interim.

Use exact E11 PathwayQueries.get_pathway(uow, condition_id, ctx) and RequestGatePort.check(uow, capability_code, subject_id, operator_id) only until accepted C4 amendments supersede them. E05 CapabilityQueries.get is a registry read and cannot recurse through this gate (docs/tdd/E05.md:141). SYSTEM names E27 KitGate; its current design 4.2 spells KitGatePort.check(uow, *, capability_code, environment_id, condition_ids) -> GateOutcome. R-E05-1/5 already requests consolidation. Require the canonical accepted name/result/snapshot binding; no compatibility copy or guessed two-argument call. Read current E23 MissionStatePort.current in the caller snapshot and accepted snapshot-bound consent and reachable operator/location facts. E31 current authority remains SYSTEM 8.4, never reconstructed from role freshness. All optional-provider missing facts are explicit unknown.

Request policy retains E11 3.7 complete capability status/reason mapping: available, unavailable, not_applicable; not_in_kit, device_absent, adapter_down, operator_absent, context_inapplicable and nullable reason. No not_in_kit promotion. Check actual configured provider/method, kit, authored clinical context, actual qualified eligible operator and current consent at proposal/acceptance/start through E05. E11 table orders status before operator; E05's plan proposes a different method/operator ordering. C4 must settle one exact order before mixed-failure behavior is implemented or exported. No new reason/error enum is authorized by this brief. Clinical unknown is non-executable with the approved configured reason/human path. Do not use applicable_environments as gravity permission: CONTRACTS 21 defines it as kit-provider presence only. Do not assume absent exclusions means unrestricted. C4 must author explicit applicability and per-test requirements with provenance. A manual alternative needs an aboard usable physical provider and selected acquisition path accepted by the same gate; a union of methods on unrelated instruments is insufficient. A null operator can represent a future assignment only under the approved consent-at-assignment rule; it is never consent granted. E05 owns request persistence/gap and revalidation dispatch.

Evidence adapter consumes E10 EvidenceQueryPort.pathway_card(release_id, condition_id) -> CardRead and read_approved(release_id, passage_id, use) -> ApprovedRead (docs/tdd/E10.md:295). Use is explicit patient_instruction, not None and not plural. ApprovedRead distinguishes Eligible, NotApprovedForUse, InReleaseHistory, NotInRelease, ReleaseUnavailable (E10 4.1). Handle every accepted result; retain missing/superseded/withdrawn discrepancies for authorized review, unavailable release as unavailable, never current-release or replacement-text fallback. C4 must complete CardRead and provider result exports before writing the mapper. Condition/kit row/card pins are one validated snapshot; do not read docs/product or open runtime evidence files directly.

Every actionable card/instruction uses real SYSTEM 8.2 GuidanceEligibility.evaluate(snapshot, GuidanceRequest), with ContentRef exact hash, purpose, release, origin, patient/location, Requirements and proposed operator. T4 supplies the accepted caller UOW/ReadSnapshot binding requested in C4; do not open a second snapshot or silently pass a UOW to a ReadSnapshot-only contract. Map GuidanceDecision outcome/availability/executable/who_can/reasons/unknown/label/clinical_review/substitute faithfully. Unknown or disallowed source/hash/purpose/pin/environment/operator/resources prevents execution. No clinical-review badge alone authorizes the whole card. Q1/Q7/Q18 permit authored eligible content in LIVE with not clinically reviewed; actual draft/simulation-only content stays in SIM and not REPLAY. A risk_context passage is background, never patient instructions. All relevant supporting/actionable material must pass exact per-purpose eligibility, not merely one supporting approved passage.

Per confirming test evaluate only its authored required capabilities, instruments, skills and operator (Part A Q26, CONTRACTS 21); unrelated capabilities of a multifunction device are irrelevant. No-instrument examination is report_or_exam for presentation, not an operator bypass. Missing explicit test requirements makes the test non-executable pending C4. Do not infer a diagnosis, confirmation or gap closure from a runnable test. Evaluation remains a read; E05 independently gates a later proposal. E12 owns get_pathway ToolResult projection and E13 shows notices/discrepancies, so do not add tools/HTTP/UI here.

Write T040 to 044 and T050 to 053 first, with Hypothesis for request and pathway rule combinations. Correct frozen unreviewed tests to distinguish clinical-review label from source/purpose/draft rejection. Check missing/rejected card/row, mixed purpose support, other release, withdrawn/superseded/missing passage, source/hash mismatch, release unavailable, Earth-only instruction in microgravity, explicit simulation-only SIM/LIVE/REPLAY, unknown provider and operator missing/away/incapacitated. Test all status/reason cases and combined-failure precedence after C4 settles it. Test instrument-free trained examination, partial required capability versus unrelated device output, adapter loss with successful chosen manual path and instrument-absent alternative rejection. Consent revocation/operator departure between checks must fail. Safe scratch kit label edit changes rendered GateResult without code and without altering levels/eligibility mappings. Configuration-derived inputs and independent denial golden expectations are distinct. T045 here proves read-only behavior with declared ports; T4 must prove actual accepted-answer/tool/proposal/gap stack and V17/V78/D06/D30 through real providers. Done requires complete approved mappings, bounded deterministic pure rules and all owned gates.

Configuration boundary: kit-map.json supplies capabilities/instruments/kits/conditions, environment-profiles.json supplies context through E23, role-rules.json supplies authority/availability through E31, and ui-copy.json supplies refusal/discrepancy/review wording through consumers. Exact clinical applicability/per-test requirements await C4 in the single accepted signed document. E10 owns condition-assessments-119.json runtime copies and evidence releases. Use these providers/pins, not direct docs/product reads or edits. No setting enables a refused safety check.

ticket_tasks.title: Urgency workflows, effect recovery and real-stack acceptance
ticket_tasks.brief:
Read AGENTS.md, docs/SYSTEM.md and docs/requests/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md first, in that order, then every reads entry. This is the complete fresh-session brief. Edit only owned_paths from E11 section 13. Recheck the current tree, all docs/build/*/tasks.json and provider declarations before creating files. At planning time no hub/, ui/ or eval/ exists and config/contracts contain only pharmacy artifacts. Create no replacement provider, generated type, clinical content, shared toolchain or sample-data fallback. The design is frozen. No git commands. No em/en dash or spaced hyphen dash. No edits to requests or AI-USE-LOG.md; return the exact missing declaration and AI-use evidence to the coordinator.

SYSTEM 5.1 supplies IdFactory/require_id; 5.2 supplies Clock/TimeInput/corrections/segments; 5.3 supplies MissionClock; 5.4 supplies Decimal Quantity/Unit and wire conversion; 5.5 supplies ProblemError/StorageUnavailable and generated ErrorEnvelope mapping under D5; 5.6 supplies snapshot-bound ReleaseHandle/ConfigReader/ConfigReleaseReader; 5.7 supplies StorageSession, UnitOfWork, ReadSnapshot, Actor/SessionContext, domain bus, outbox and replication; 5.8 supplies CommandIdentity, IdempotencyStore, CommandIntents, CommandReceipts and ResultVisibility; 5.9 supplies whole-envelope reference-only audit; 5.10/5.10.1 supply scheduler, health, task execution and generations; 5.10.2 supplies EvaluationIsolation; 5.11 supplies bounded HubSettings/SettingSpec; 5.12 supplies ModuleRegistry. Use these by their exact declarations, never a local clock, ledger, UOW, worker queue, retry, hash chain or concurrency mechanism. SYSTEM 6 governs uv --project hub, generated contracts and import discovery. SYSTEM 8.1 fixes E11/E26 ownership, 8.2 clinical eligibility, 8.3 privacy, 8.4 authority, 8.5 home/location and 8.6 durability. Part A D1/D3/D5/D6/D7/D12/D13 and Q1/Q4/Q7/Q16/Q18/Q26 override frozen text. Clinical review is an independent visible label; missing source/hash/purpose/applicability never permits guidance.

Hard prerequisites are real E01/E02/E15-core/E27-guidance (SYSTEM 9); build unit work against exact published ports and E01 kernel.testing (SYSTEM 10) once available. Fakes are test fixtures, never production fallbacks. Optional model/devices/ground cannot block fixed help, record entry or safety. Read PLAN Design deviations and C1 to C9 as binding build direction. They are pending coordinator handoffs because this planning run may edit only docs/build/E11/ and docs/requests/E11.md is absent. Pending schemas/proposals are not callable contracts. Before dependent implementation require accepted complete declarations, generated effective models and provider tests. Work independently where those gaps do not apply. A disabled feature preserves safety but does not satisfy acceptance.

Write critical tests first. Carry T-E11 IDs plus R/V/D or invariant traces from E11 section 12. Use real configuration-derived inputs through explicit test/demo profiles and independently source-checked expected safety outcomes; never derive both a medical input and its expected answer from the same document. Hypothesis covers every classifier/parser/rule. Do not edit safety mappings to prove configurability. Test null/empty/negative/maximum, changed unit where quantities occur, all LIVE/REPLAY/SIM states and source/time lineage. Storage/I/O/integrity errors propagate; privacy caches/logs/errors hold only approved codes/references. A bug gets a failing regression first and the full hub suite after fixing. Gates must execute nonempty owned tests, with no skips/xfails, filters hiding failures or ignored warnings. Done means all assigned tests and exact gates pass, accepted seams are delivered and evidence distinguishes planned from executed, unit doubles from real-stack acceptance, and numerical verification from clinical validation. Final epic greenlight also requires T4, CI, independent review and coordinator AI-use rows. No task edits another task's files; report fixes to their owner.

Build E11 4.1 to 4.6, 5.2 role/effect adapters, conditional section 6 router and the complete sections 9 to 12/15 acceptance. T1 owns pure safety/types/events, T2 SQLite, T3 pure gates/evidence mapper. Reuse them; no duplicated mechanisms. Consume completed T1/T2/T3 and the real mandatory provider stack. C1 must supply convention-discovered pathways/module.py outside this task's ownership: do not hide register in __init__.py, edit shared assembly, create an unowned module.py or invent a test-only app. Supply the coordinator the exact factory/binding/registration references your owned implementations expose. Missing production registration blocks HTTP/end-to-end acceptance.

Implement OnAnswerAccepted, OnHelpSessionChanged, OnPersonWarningRaised, RequestReviewFromModel, StartResponse, RecordDisposition, BeforeTurn/StillValid, GateRequest, GetPathway and RunEffects named in E11 4.1 (docs/tdd/E11.md:272). E01 records publishes the canonical AnswerAccepted in the caller producer UOW after mandatory episode attachment, once; do not republish. C2 settles the exact AnswerRecord and producer order. Register the classifier through SYSTEM 5.10.2 EvaluationIsolation, using original TimeInput, release, partition and immutable evaluator/completion identity. On EvaluatorComputationFailure only, original input/pending/retry/reference-only fault audit commit while old safety state is retained; no accepted response can imply evaluation succeeded. Authorization/config/input/storage/I/O/integrity faults must abort capture. Test permanent computation failure, every forbidden failure class, pending-marker/audit write failure, duplicate recovery and older recovery after a newer state. Health uses declared overall degraded until R-SYS-9 adds details.

Use T2 repository for signal, cycle, link and immutable effect intent in the same producer UOW as audit/events/replication/command receipt. Publish the accepted UrgencyChanged in that UOW; E15 bumps its Episode revision/timeline there. C2/C3 must align exact cause/ref fields before binding. Subscribe durably to help.session_changed and warning.raised under SYSTEM 5.7; handler work and cursor commit together, duplicates no-op and storage error redelivers. Validate subject/mission/origin/home and current authorized references from trusted historical facts, never current mission mode as opening provenance. Ignore operational/non-rule/non-act-or-emergency warnings for urgency. Never use an imported replica event as a new local cause or rerun an old effect; local home is authoritative and a remote finding is a new local record under SYSTEM 8.5. HelpClosed is history only, never disposition.

HelpEntryPort.open_from_red_flag(episode_id, answer_id, subject_person_id, flow_id, client_time, idempotency_key) -> str is SYSTEM 8.1, implemented by E26 in its own transaction. Use opener engine, Episode ref_id and its shared durable command identity, never patient impersonation. Joining does not reset flow. Record the returned session link explicitly, not solely by original public entry.ref_id. C3 must provide complete durable cause/cycle/pin/provenance association and receipt/reconciliation behavior; do not copy E28 PlanEscalation/HelpEscalationReceipt for red flags. Replayed old positive cannot reopen a closed incident/session; a genuinely new positive after closure can open help. Old help effects/events after disposition attach historical consequences without a fabricated cycle. Test button-session/other-episode/different-flow joins, closed-session/new-answer, and disposition before effect, event or retry.

Effects use SYSTEM 5.10/5.10.1, not a serial feature-owned queue. pathways_effect retains bounded reference input/progress; shared generation, leases, retry, pending and exhaustion own delivery. Help and cancel are independently schedulable per C7, so blocked optional cancellation never delays help. Calls are outside all write UOWs, under registered deadlines; a result and receipt reconcile in a new short UOW. AssistantTurnControl.cancel_episode_turns only sets cancel state and returns, never waits on inference (E13 4.2). Missing E13 is no active turn, while stale guard still fences output. Missing E26 leaves a visible pending help intent and fixed cached/printed entry; it cannot turn an intent into a successful session. Exhaustion remains visible with shared explicit retry of the original intent, no dropped accepted work. Retry delay/lease are ElapsedDeadline with original TimeInput; absolute stated deadlines never shift. C7 must define all admission/durable overflow/rearm behavior and SettingSpec limits before this runner is enabled. Register no public Job kind for effects. Bound pages, linked summaries, task claims and calls by section 8/11 settings through C1, not literals.

role_reader maps SYSTEM 8.4 ClinicalAuthorityQuery.authority(view, person_id, subject_person_id, action urgency_disposition, dose None, at uow.now) to T1 domain proof in the same write UOW. Use canonical keywords exactly from the published provider. Query unavailable or none refuses. Current actor must be non-patient and have object/field/purpose permission; officer rank/assignment grants no chart. No role-provider external call spans the transaction. Authorized acting records retain assignment and acting label; retired/closed/replaced assignment, returned officers and changed location are checked at command time. Q16 does not permit acting clinician_assessed episode resolution.

E11 owns no current OpenAPI operation (E11 6). Implement actOnEpisodeUrgency at POST /v1/episodes/{episode_id}/urgency only after C6/R-SYS-33 exact schema and initial readable projection are accepted and generated. Closed body is either action start_response, or action record_disposition plus positive cycle/cycle_revision, existing HelpAction close disposition and nonempty rationale; no invented UrgencyAction fields. Roles crew and crew_medical_officer, mandatory Idempotency-Key and Episode If-Match, 200 generated Episode. Enforce current grant/authority, Episode revision and cycle/revision atomically. Initial GET must supply required concurrency fields, not stale errors. Use exact approved error set/statuses: MALFORMED_REQUEST 400, UNAUTHENTICATED 401, ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED/UNAUTHORIZED_SCOPE 403, NOT_FOUND 404, INVALID_TRANSITION/STALE_VERSION/DUPLICATE_COMMAND 409, UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE 415, INVALID_VALUE 422, VERSION_REQUIRED 428 and INTERNAL_ERROR through approved default; current_state obeys visibility. C6 must settle that declaration table before exposure. Kernel StorageUnavailable maps per SYSTEM 5.5; no separate StorageBusy. Keep full identity and current ResultVisibility check on retries, including changed target/body/revision and matching late receipt beyond 24 hours. Never cache rationale/answer/model text. E26 retains openHelpSession/createUrgentEvent; E15 retains startEpisode/getEpisode and E04 answerEpisode; E11 adds none of their routers.

BeforeTurn and StillValid use the C5 complete token and caller snapshot. Bind E13/E12's material revision, current grant and generation verification in their existing publication/apply UOW, not a bool checked before a later commit. Nonurgent material corrections also stale output. E13 must invalidate queued client output after a changed snapshot; no added public E11 event. Before R-SYS-32, E15 uses registered bounded refresh through getEpisode with stale/offline text. Unsupported pathway/gate remains an explicit non-executable result and human path; no inferred diagnosis or task. Use exact SYSTEM 8.2 GuidanceEligibility snapshot/purpose/hash and T3 result mapping, rechecked at actual E05 proposal/accept/start. C4 must supply its UOW/read snapshot binding.

Privacy at every exit follows SYSTEM 8.3. help.session_changed is authorized P2, other crew/station get only CrewBroadcast through help.broadcast_changed; subscription itself is not a read grant. No automatic E29 clinical catch-up line or ground send without the owner's approved projection. Local urgency has no approved broad replica export; export_projection None plus reference-only recovery metadata. Test unauthorized event readers, caches, saved receipts, logs, exports/ground with canaries and current revocation. No empty export/fake provider counts as complete V26. T0 works on a laptop with optional model/devices/link/tablets absent; T1/T2 add clients, T3 devices, T4/T5 feeds, T6 separate authoritative hubs/local kit and operators, T7 approved snapshot transport only (DEPLOYMENT 3 to 5).

Write application/fault regressions first for T006 to 010/013 to 017/020 to 032/045/050/052/053/061 to 065/070 to 073/080 to 084. Every AGENTS 6 failure applies: crash/power loss at each acceptance/effect boundary, duplicate/long-outage replay, forward/backward clock and mission-day boundary, full disk/locked/I/O/integrity, missing/corrupt config, partial/implausible/conflicting real readings through E01, concurrent clients, link backlog, absent/incapacitated crew and cross-crew privacy. Inject computation failure only through documented evaluator seam; use real repository/UOW for storage faults. Test both disposition/signal races and permanent evaluator failure, optional cancellation saturation and exhausted recovery. SQL backup gets a domain-bypass test through T2, and stale-output backup is tested with cancellation delivery removed.

Own every complete end-to-end scenario under hub/tests/pathways/e2e. Drive HTTP through create_app(settings), real temporary SQLite and the real installed modules; E21 seeds fixtures/demo-mara-fd19 via explicit demo profile and API, never direct SQL or completed example state. No mocks inside the hub or dependency overrides. Published external model/device adapters may be absent/faked; real E26/E31/E24/E10/E05/E12/E13/E15 are required for scenarios exercising their success. Browser clauses use E21's published Python Playwright driver against that running hub; do not invent fixture/import names or edit UI. C1/C9 must publish the harness first. Missing scenario/provider fails acceptance, never skip/xfail.

Mandatory matrix: (1) R15, V01/V61, D05/D15, real red-flag questions before first model request, yes fixed flow before network, unknown retained and help offered; stopped model, active capture and link down; hub-off cached first screen at most 500 ms p95; reconnect one logical session. Remove client after answer commit and kill/restart twice before help/cancel delivery. (2) V03, actual E01 measurement to sourced E24 observation rule to E11 response/help, without repeat prerequisite; a fabricated Warning is consumer-only and C3/R-E24-5 blocks the real case. (3) R28/V04/V32, actual acknowledgment/normal repeat/review/help close/forecast/model no lowering, attribution, current granted officer/acting independent disposition with no help, both concurrency orders, new real cause versus old consequence; E14 owns actual forecast, E18 is not its provider. (4) V16 and durability, original question/help pins after removal/remapping, button/other-episode/different-flow/closed session, disposition before effect/event/retry, multiweek replay after cache expiry and disposition creates one answer/signal, changed target conflicts, every crash/storage boundary and cursor restart preserves accepted state. (5) V27/R28, real E13/E12 with documented external blocked/malformed model; cancellation failure plus independent stale guard, change between validation and publication, ordinary correction, equal cycle numbers on two episodes, incomplete/stale UI. (6) V24/E11-02, actual E10/E27/E12 pinned pathway, visible missing/withdrawn/superseded discrepancy, Earth-only instruction in microgravity, mixed-purpose support, not clinically reviewed label without clinical-signoff gate, actual SIM-only content fenced in LIVE/REPLAY, accepted answer through read tool to real E05 command. (7) R07/V17/V78/D06/D30, actual standing-test denial/gap/review, camera pulse with kit/provider, nonempty reason and decision_affected plus heart region, ECG never reaches patient/task and persists unresolved gap/form link in actual handoff; operator departure/consent revocation/adapter failure revalidation, successful selected manual capture after failed adapter, absent physical instrument refusal. (8) V26/V40, separate LIVE/SIM/REPLAY and mission/home, delayed help/warning after mode change, no real SIM external message, unrelated crew only P0, private journal/report canaries absent from all real exits. (9) T065/070 to 073, second open client updates within approved refresh, offline/stale/acting labels, safe label/hint edit changes served/rendered content, rejected corrupt config retains last good release, old work pins remain. (10) T064/080 to 084 and all critical invariants, permanent evaluator fail with pending fault versus forbidden errors rollback, backwards elapsed retries and absolute deadlines, saturation/overflow/exhaustion with help still available, 1000 signals bounded/paged without loss, two disconnected hubs with local reachable kit/operators and no replica history effects. Measure design section 11 classification/gate/pathway/help-under-load budgets on stated reference hardware; do not claim unrun hardware/CI evidence.

Gates below run all owned application/end-to-end evidence then the full hub regression with branch JSON. C1 must extend E01 validate_hub.py coverage/safety/mutations/trace inventories to all E11 executable domain/application files; the current E01-only inventory cannot greenlight E11. Require at least 95 percent branches independently per module without aggregate dilution, full true/false safety conditions, complexity at most 15, missing/unmeasured/empty collection failures and reviewed non-equivalent critical mutants on urgency/red_flags/authority/inference_gate/request_gate (E11 12, SYSTEM 12). No invented gate script or ignored failure. Done means complete matrix, no open blocker/major masquerading as a pass, all gates, actual provider evidence, resolved independent build review and CI. Return an AI-use row for coordinator recording.

Configuration and bounds handoff: consume questionnaires.json, help-presentation.json, responder-flows.json, kit-map.json and role-rules.json at the work pin, warning-rules.json via E24, ui-copy.json through renderers. Register the design section 8 names effect_batch_size, effect_call_timeout_ms, effect_retry_backoff_seconds, effect_max_attempts, effect_queue_alarm_depth, max_linked_sessions and episode_refresh_seconds through C1/C7 with SYSTEM 5.11 validation, in addition to storage/event/task/scheduler/evaluation bounds supplied by E01. Signal page cap is CONTRACTS section 5 maximum 200, enforced through the accepted setting, not a configurable weakening of that contract. C7 must publish finite ceilings for memory/backlog/admission before enabling delivery. T080 <=2 ms classification, T081 <=200 ms help server p95 under stated load, T082 <=2 ms gate checks, T083 <=5 ms for 20 tests and T084 bounded summary/page behavior are E11 section 11 measurement obligations, never new hardcoded domain content.

Do not treat accepted-but-evaluation_pending answers as completed safety classification. Bind the approved C5 pending-evaluation result into BeforeTurn and rendered degraded/human-path state; original capture remains durable. The gate cannot start/apply a clinical model result on unknown urgent evaluation. All ruff/mypy/pytest commands explicitly select hub/pyproject.toml, so the root pharmacy configuration cannot mask E11 failures.
